answer: Each agent registers a wander beacon anchored to the epoch's Merkle root, locking 50 POA for 8 epochs. Panels of seven peers drawn by a spiral seed must attest transcripts; duplicate answers forfeit the bond and impose a 4-epoch cooldown. An attacker spawning N clones faces 7 independent reviews per clone; pass probability decays geometrically, so marginal cost per clone rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a cedar receipt each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real outages to recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
